item.text: I’m trimming the pass API now so it returns a plain integer instead of `int | None`. That removes one sentinel path in the core loop and keeps the control flow simpler.
The loop is now integer-only, so the state object no longer needs a sentinel branch. I’m verifying the file and the entrypoints now to make sure the sort still stops at the right time.

item.text:
Refactored the core bubble-sort loop in [`bubble_sort/core.py`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/bubble_sort/bubble_sort/core.py#L23) to simplify the state flow.

- `_ComparisonState.bubble_pass(...)` now returns an `int` instead of `int | None`, so the pass logic has one less sentinel path.
- `bubble_sort(...)` now exits when the pass returns `0`, which keeps the same behavior but makes the loop easier to follow.
- Public API and CLI behavior are unchanged.
